title: The RLS policy set denies every service operation

role_assignments._run_id_disambiguation: /claude/r0_steward (Anthropic) is THIS package's Integration Owner and must record its own capability declaration before this package leaves backlog. /root/r0_steward (OpenAI Codex) is a DIFFERENT run: it is the Integration Owner of WP-0A-A0-001 and WP-0A-CON-001 and is named in open_blockers solely because it must countersign the amendments made to those two packages and record the WP-0A-CON-001 npm run check addendum. Neither run substitutes for the other. Independent testing flagged the near-identical names as ambiguous; both are intended.

independence.cross_vendor_exception: prefer_cross_vendor_review is NOT satisfied: every assigned run is Anthropic claude-opus-5. The Decision Register (§ cross-vendor review) permits this only as an explicit exception - 'if there is no cross-vendor capacity, use an independent agent per run and record the exception'. Each of the five roles is a separate agent run with its own capability declaration and no run reviewed, tested, or integrated its own work. The Integration Owner must carry this exception forward; it is not waived and it is not equivalent to cross-vendor review.

required_human_authorities: A0 countersignature on the service-path half of DATA-DEC-03; A1 proposed the security half and declined to close alone.
Product Owner and A0 to decide the service path (supabase-js with the service-role key, or a direct driver with per-request SET LOCAL role), due before G1.
purpose: The data package specifies tenant policies TO authenticated only, and marks a long list of operations service-only. RFC-2026-012 is approved and commits the client/database boundary to FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Under forced RLS with a policy set naming one role, every service operation is denied, so the only way to run the specification as written is for the service path to bypass RLS -- the precise thing forcing prevents. Found by the A1 analysis solicited for DATA-DEC-03, before any migration exists. This package records the defect, its fix, the database platform the Product Owner decided, and how far DATA-DEC-03 can close.

include: RFC-2026-016 recording the policy-set defect and the amendment that fixes it
The Product Owner's decision that the platform is Supabase, which the register never carried
The part of DATA-DEC-03 that closes independently of the undecided service path
The acceptance-test gaps DB-00 must close, named specifically
exclude: Closing DATA-DEC-03. The service path is undecided, and on Supabase the service-role key bypasses RLS, so claiming the control now would record one that does not exist.
Any migration, schema or lint implementation. This package records decisions; DB-00 implements them.
Disposing this RFC. That is the Product Owner's act on a disposition branch.

amends_without_owning.rationale: The four registries that must move when a branch or a decision record is added, and which exist so that adding one is a deliberate act in a diff. RFC-2026-016 is added to the protected-file list and the pinned decision-record set, and digested; this branch is added to the branch-to-package mapping. No floor is lowered and no existing row is changed.

acceptance_criteria: The RFC states the contradiction between the TO authenticated policy rule and the service-only matrix rows, and shows why forced RLS denies every service operation.
The fix adds no permission the matrix does not already grant, and says so.
The platform decision is recorded as the Product Owner's, dated, with the reason it had to be recorded at all.
DATA-DEC-03 closes only as far as the undecided service path allows, and the RFC refuses to claim the control beyond that.
The provenance section states plainly that the A1 analysis was spawned from the A0 session and is not independent in the sense no_self_approval intends.
The RFC is committed with status Proposed.
required_tests: The work-package and ownership validators accept this manifest
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. One Proposed decision record; no schema, migration, contract, persisted data, provider state or credential touched.
open_blockers: RFC-2026-016 is Proposed. Until disposed, batch 000 must not be written against the authenticated-only policy shape.
The service path is undecided. On Supabase the service-role key bypasses RLS, so DATA-DEC-03 cannot close as scoped and no document may state that forced RLS constrains the service path.
The A1 analysis was spawned from the A0 session and does not satisfy no_self_approval or prefer_cross_vendor_review. Recorded as A0-solicited analysis.
Gate G0 remains Specification Baseline Complete / External Verification Pending; a Proposed decision record is reversible, synthetic-only work.
